name: ./AGENT Protocol
description: Agent-native DeFi toolkit for wallets, swaps, bridges, lending, yield, and market intelligence across supported EVM networks including Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base. Zcash gateway support is planned, not live.

authentication.note: Send an AGENT API key with the x-agnt-api-key header, or use a scoped connector URL.

skills.name: Token Swap
skills.description: Discover EVM liquidity and compare routed swaps. Direct Uniswap and PancakeSwap execution is disabled; supported route execution depends on adapter availability and safety checks.
examples: Quote 100 USDC to WETH on Base
Find liquidity for PEPE on Ethereum

skills.name: Cross-Chain Bridge
skills.description: Compare and execute supported EVM bridge routes through Relay or Jumper/LiFi, subject to adapter availability and safety checks.
examples: Bridge 500 USDC from Ethereum to Arbitrum
Get a quote for bridging ETH to Base

skills.name: Lending & Borrowing
skills.description: Supply/withdraw assets on Aave V3 and Morpho optimized vaults across multiple chains.
examples: Supply 1000 USDC to Aave on Ethereum

skills.name: Yield & Staking
skills.description: Liquid staking via Lido, yield tokenization on Pendle, and protocol information for Ethena and Ondo. Minting depends on issuer eligibility and onboarding.
examples: Show Pendle markets sorted by APY

skills.name: Market Intelligence
skills.description: Prices, charts, gas fees, whale tracking, token security, sentiment, and DEX pool discovery.
